'''Sun Rock Retreat''' {{co|50.1|60.8|Stonetalon Mountains}} is a nice, [[tauren]]-style, [[Horde]] settlement in middle of the [[Stonetalon Mountains]], south of [[Mirkfallon Lake]]. 

== Facilities ==
* [[Flight Path]]
* [[Inn]] and [[Mailbox]]
* [[Forge]] and [[Anvil]]
* Repairs ([[Borand]] the Bowyer, near the wyvern)
* Many quests
* [[Artisan]] [[Enchanter]]
